title: Load change rule
lead: No pickup or delivery address changes until BOTH of these are done:
must: We call the broker or shipper back on a number we already have (from the rate confirmation or our records). Never the number or link in the email.
A second person OKs the change before the driver is told.
warnings: An email address that is slightly different

title: Bank details change rule
lead: Nobody changes a supplier's, carrier's, or customer's bank details until BOTH of these are done:
must: We call the company back on a number we already had on file. Never the number in the email asking for the change.
A second person approves any large payment to the new details.
warnings: A request to pay before the usual date
Pressure to keep it quiet or rush it
An email address that is slightly different

title: If we get hacked: who to call
lead: If a computer is locked, money goes missing, or an email account is taken over, stay calm and work down this list:
must: Unplug the affected computer from the network (pull the cable or turn off Wi-Fi). Do not turn it off.
If money was sent, call the bank right away. Speed matters for getting it back.
Call the people below, then tell customers whose shipments or data could be affected.

contacts.role: Whoever set up our email and computers
